title: Finally made a proper trailer for my survivorlike Void Descent
author: BRaiNDED_Games
selftext:
I finally had to make a real trailer for the upcoming steam version of my game Void Descent. The game has been about 10 months in the making and I'm really excited to get it live on Steam (having a game on Steam was always a deal of mine but I had no dev experience)

I used Claude Code (mostly Sonnet but some Opus and Fable for more complex planning) and a combination of Suno and Magnific for assistance with 3D models and audio assets.

It's built in HTML and uses Three.js for the 3D graphics mode. This is my first ever attempt at making a game and I'm super proud of where it is right now.

Steam demo should be live by next week, let me know what you think!

comments.author: mendlogames
comments.body: Looks good. No stutters. Very smooth

replies.author: BRaiNDED_Games
replies.body: Thank you! There was a LOT of time spent on optimization making sure it ran smooth on all devices and offered flexible options.

comments.author: christianstrang
comments.body:
This looks great, I wouldn't be able to tell that it's build using AI, good job 👍🏻 

Side note: I wasn't aware you could release threejs games on steam, did you wrap it with something to create an .exe file or how does it work?

replies.author: BRaiNDED_Games
replies.body:
I appreciate it, that's probably the highest compliment for this stuff 🙌🏻

I'm using Electron so it's essentially just running the whole game in a chromium browser shell. I'll be launching the game for Windows and Linux (for steamOS / steam deck)
